task: Determine whether hidden finite-state controlled CTMC mechanisms can be actively separated when their observable CLE drift/covariance agree pointwise under every allowed action, including unknown rates and hidden states.
status_note: Exact finite-state IO-equivalence lemma and actionwise-CLE collision witness derived; numerical arithmetic checks passed; biological interface remains unacquired.
inherited_inputs: work/ROOT_MANDATE.txt and required Astra start/core/workflow files
prior cell_observation_design cycle2/3 artifacts and cell_lineage_graph cycle3 comparison
finite-state CTMC/HMM definitions and primary literature
acquired_inputs: Astra N35 controlled chemical safety card from the pinned commit
Astra N58 kinetic regularization card checked and excluded as unrelated
primary-source interfaces for HMC equivalence, active Markov-chain design, Transcompp, and Gunnarsson/Foo/Leder

representation.controlled_hidden_model: finite CTMC with hidden phase h, observable scalar x, finite actions passive/active/reset, fixed duration pulse, marked jump outputs
representation.observation_interface: x path and jump-size mark; active classification endpoint records whether x remains at the center state
representation.candidate_parameters: theta is active hidden-switch rate; c and kappa are unknown nuisance rates with supplied compact caps or pilot confidence sets

load_bearing_result: Actionwise equality of observable b and A does not imply controlled input/output equivalence. Conversely, equality of all finite controlled action/output word probabilities is the exact no-adaptive-separation boundary.

bounded_check.method: standard-library Python evaluation of actionwise CLE fields, killed-CTMC survival formulas, robust survival gaps, and Hoeffding sample arithmetic
bounded_check.result: 30 field checks returned exact floating-point difference zero; class survival ranges disjoint over c in [0.9,1.1]; mixed-phase 5%-per-hypothesis Hoeffding count 7207
bounded_check.limit: finite arithmetic check only; matrix formulas were analytically derived, not externally reviewed; no biological validation

next_gate: Acquire an actual observation/action interface and finite rate confidence sets; certify robust safe-action separation and compare against calibrated controlled-HMM and lineage-tree baselines.
